4.133.s:
śaunaka uvāca
adhya me saphalaṃ janma cīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam .
yatphalaṃ brahmavaivarte nirvighnaṃ mokṣakāraṇam .. 1 ..
4.133.d:
शौनक उवाच
अध्य मे सफलं जन्म चीवितं च सुजीवितम् ।
यत्फलं ब्रह्मवैवर्ते निर्विघ्नं मोक्षकारणम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.133.s:
abhayaṃ dehi he vatsa he tāta mahyameva ca .
tadā nivedanaṃ kiṃcidastīti ca karomyaham .. 2 ..
4.133.d:
अभयं देहि हे वत्स हे तात मह्यमेव च ।
तदा निवेदनं किंचिदस्तीति च करोम्यहम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.133.m: Grant me fearlessness, O dear one, O child, to me indeed; / then I shall make a certain petition that I have. // 2

4.133.s:
sūta uvāca
tyaja bhītiṃ mahābhāga praśnaṃ kuru yadicchasi .
sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi yadyadgopyaṃ manoharam .. 3 ..
4.133.d:
सूत उवाच
त्यज भीतिं महाभाग प्रश्नं कुरु यदिच्छसि ।
सर्वं ते कथयिष्यामि यद्यद्गोप्यं मनोहरम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.133.m: Sūta said: / Cast off fear, O highly fortunate one; ask whatever question you desire! / I will tell you everything, whatever is secret and enchanting. // 3

4.133.s:
śaunaka uvāca
adhunā śrotumicchāmi purāṇānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam .
saṃkhyānamapi teṣāṃ ca phalamasyaiva putraka .. 4 ..
4.133.d:
शौनक उवाच
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि पुराणानां च लक्षणम् ।
संख्यानमपि तेषां च फलमस्यैव पुत्रक ॥ 4 ॥
4.133.m: Śaunaka said: / Now I wish to hear the characteristics of the Purāṇas, / and their enumeration, as well as the fruit of this, O dear child! // 4

4.133.s:
sūta uvāca
vistarāṇi purāṇāni cetihāsaśca śaunaka .
saṃhitāṃ pañcarātrāṇi kathayāmi yathāgatam .. 5 ..
4.133.d:
सूत उवाच
विस्तराणि पुराणानि चेतिहासश्च शौनक ।
संहितां पञ्चरात्राणि कथयामि यथागतम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.133.m: Sūta said: / Extensive are the Purāṇas, as well as the history, O Śaunaka; / I shall relate the Saṃhitās and the Pañcarātras as handed down by tradition. // 5

4.133.s:
sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca .
vaṃśānucaritaṃ vipra purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam .. 6 ..
4.133.d:
सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च ।
वंशानुचरितं विप्र पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.133.m: Creation and secondary creation, lineage, the Manu-periods, / and the deeds of lineages, O vipra, are the five characteristics of a Purāṇa. // 6

4.133.s:
etadupapurāṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ .
mahatāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmi te .. 7 ..
4.133.d:
एतदुपपुराणानां लक्षणं च विदुर्बुधाः ।
महतां च पुराणानां लक्षणं कथयामि ते ॥ 7 ॥
4.133.m: The wise know this to be the characteristic of the Upapurāṇas; / I shall relate to you the characteristic of the great Purāṇas. // 7

4.133.s:
sṛṣṭiścāpi visṛṣṭiśca sthitisteṣāṃ ca pālanam .
karmaṇāṃ vāsanā vārtāmanūnāṃ cākrameṇa ca .. 8 ..
4.133.d:
सृष्टिश्चापि विसृष्टिश्च स्थितिस्तेषां च पालनम् ।
कर्मणां वासना वार्तामनूनां चाक्रमेण च ॥ 8 ॥
4.133.m: Primary creation and secondary creation, maintenance, preservation of those [beings], / the latent impressions of actions, the chronicles of the Manus in succession, // 8

4.133.s:
varṇanaṃ pralayānāṃ ca maukṣasya ca nirūpaṇam .
utkīrtanaṃ harereva vedānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak .. 9 ..
4.133.d:
वर्णनं प्रलयानां च मौक्षस्य च निरूपणम् ।
उत्कीर्तनं हरेरेव वेदानां च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 9 ॥
4.133.m: the description of dissolutions, the determination of liberation, / the glorification of Hari alone, and of each of the Vedas individually— // 9

4.133.s:
daśādhikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca mahatāṃ parikīrtitam .
saṃkhyānaṃ ca purāṇānāṃ nibodha kathayāmi te .. 10 ..
4.133.d:
दशाधिकं लक्षणं च महतां परिकीर्तितम् ।
संख्यानं च पुराणानां निबोध कथयामि ते ॥ 10 ॥
4.133.m: these ten characteristics of the great [Purāṇas] are proclaimed. / Learn from me the extent of the Purāṇas; I shall tell you: // 10

4.133.s:
paraṃ brahmapurāṇaṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ daśaiva tu .
pañconaṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ pādmameva prakīrtitam .. 11 ..
4.133.d:
परं ब्रह्मपुराणं च सहस्राणां दशैव तु ।
पञ्चोनषष्टिसाहस्रं पाद्ममेव प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.133.m: The supreme Brahma Purāṇa consists of ten thousand [verses]; / the Padma is proclaimed to have fifty-five thousand. // 11

4.133.s:
trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ .
caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ śaivaṃ caiva nirūpitam .. 12 ..
4.133.d:
त्रयोविंशतिसाहस्रं वैष्णवं च विदुर्बुधाः ।
चतुर्विंशतिसाहस्रं शैवं चैव निरूपितम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.133.m: The wise know the Vaiṣṇava to have twenty-three thousand; / and the Śaiva is determined to have twenty-four thousand. // 12

4.133.s:
grantho'ṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ viduḥ .
pañcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ nāradīyaṃ prakīrtitam .. 13 ..
4.133.d:
ग्रन्थोऽष्टादशसाहस्रं श्रीमद्भागवतं विदुः ।
पञ्चविंशतिसाहस्रं नारदीयं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.133.m: They know the Śrīmad Bhāgavata text to have eighteen thousand; / the Nāradīya is proclaimed to have twenty-five thousand. // 13

4.133.s:
mārkaṇḍaṃ navasāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ paṇḍitā viduḥ .
catuḥśatādhikaṃ pañcadaśasāhasrameva ca .. 14 ..
4.133.d:
मार्कण्डं नवसाहस्रं पुराणं पण्डिता विदुः ।
चतुःशताधिकं पञ्चदशसाहस्रमेव च ॥ 14 ॥
4.133.m: Learned men know the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa to have nine thousand; / and fifteen thousand four hundred // 14

4.133.s:
paramagnipurāṇaṃ ca ruciraṃ parisīrtitam .
caturdaśasahasrāṇi paraṃ pañcaśatādhikam .. 15 ..
4.133.d:
परमग्निपुराणं च रुचिरं परिसीर्तितम् ।
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि परं पञ्चशताधिकम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.133.m: is proclaimed for the supreme and delightful Agni Purāṇa; / fourteen thousand plus five hundred // 15

4.133.s:
purāṇapravaraṃ caiva bhaviṣyaṃ parikīrtitam .
aṣṭādaśasahasraṃ ca brahmavaivartamīpsitam .. 16 ..
4.133.d:
पुराणप्रवरं चैव भविष्यं परिकीर्तितम् ।
अष्टादशसहस्रं च ब्रह्मवैवर्तमीप्सितम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.133.m: is proclaimed for the Bhaviṣya, best among the Purāṇas; / and the desired Brahmavaivarta has eighteen thousand. // 16

4.133.s:
sarveṣāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ sārameva vidurbudhāḥ .
ekādaśasahasraṃ tu paraṃ liṅgapurāṇakam .. 17 ..
4.133.d:
सर्वेषां च पुराणानां सारमेव विदुर्बुधाः ।
एकादशसहस्रं तु परं लिङ्गपुराणकम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.133.m: The wise know it as the very essence of all the Purāṇas. / The supreme Liṅga Purāṇa has eleven thousand; // 17

4.133.s:
caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ vārāhaṃ parikīrtitam .
ekāśītisahasraṃ ca parameva śatādhikam .. 18 ..
4.133.d:
चतुर्विंशतिसाहस्रं वाराहं परिकीर्तितम् ।
एकाशीतिसहस्रं च परमेव शताधिकम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.133.m: the Vārāha is proclaimed to have twenty-four thousand; / eighty-one thousand and one hundred // 18

4.133.s:
varaṃ skandapurāṇaṃ ca sadbhirevaṃ nirūpitam .
vāmanaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kaurma saptadaśaiva tu .. 19 ..
4.133.d:
वरं स्कन्दपुराणं च सद्भिरेवं निरूपितम् ।
वामनं दशसाहस्रं कौर्म सप्तदशैव तु ॥ 19 ॥
4.133.m: is determined by the virtuous for the excellent Skanda Purāṇa; / the Vāmana has ten thousand, the Kūrma seventeen [thousand]; // 19

4.133.s:
mātsyaṃ caturdaśa proktaṃ purāṇaṃ paṇḍitaistathā .
ūnaviśatisāhasraṃ gāruḍaṃ parikīrtitam .. 20 ..
4.133.d:
मात्स्यं चतुर्दश प्रोक्तं पुराणं पण्डितैस्तथा ।
ऊनविशतिसाहस्रं गारुडं परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 20 ॥
4.133.m: likewise, the Matsya Purāṇa is declared by the learned to be fourteen [thousand]; / the Gāruḍa is proclaimed to have nineteen thousand; // 20

4.133.s:
paraṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ brahmāḍhaṃ parikīrtitam .
evaṃ purāṇasaṃkhyānaṃ caturlakṣamudāhṛtam .. 21 ..
4.133.d:
परं द्वादशसाहस्रं ब्रह्माढं परिकीर्तितम् ।
एवं पुराणसंख्यानं चतुर्लक्षमुदाहृतम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.133.m: the supreme Brahmāṇḍa is proclaimed to have twelve thousand. / Thus the total number of [verses in] the Purāṇas is said to be four hundred thousand. // 21

4.133.s:
aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāmevameva vidurbudhāḥ .
evaṃ copapurāṇānāmaṣṭādaśa prakīrtitā .. 22 ..
4.133.d:
अष्टादशपुराणानामेवमेव विदुर्बुधाः ।
एवं चोपपुराणानामष्टादश प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 22 ॥
4.133.m: Thus the wise know the eighteen Purāṇas; / and likewise, eighteen Upapurāṇas are proclaimed. // 22

4.133.s:
itihāso bhārataṃ ca vānmīkaṃ kāvyameva ca .
pañcakaṃ pañcarātrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇamāhātmyapūrvakam .. 23 ..
4.133.d:
इतिहासो भारतं च वान्मीकं काव्यमेव च ।
पञ्चकं पञ्चरात्राणां कृष्णमाहात्म्यपूर्वकम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.133.m: The Mahābhārata is the history, and Vālmīki's [work] is the epic poem; / the fivefold collection of Pañcarātras is dedicated to the greatness of Kṛṣṇa: // 23

4.133.s:
vasiṣṭhaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca kāpilaṃ gautamīyakam .
paraṃ sanatkumārīyaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca pañcakam .. 24 ..
4.133.d:
वसिष्ठं नारदीयं च कापिलं गौतमीयकम् ।
परं सनत्कुमारीयं पञ्चरात्रं च पञ्चकम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.133.m: the Vāsiṣṭha, the Nāradīya, the Kāpila, the Gautamīya, / and the supreme Sanatkumārīya make up the five Pañcarātras. // 24

4.133.s:
pañcakaṃ sahitānāṃ ca kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitam .
brahmaṇāśca śivasyāpi prahlādasya tathaiva ca .. 25 ..
4.133.d:
पञ्चकं सहितानां च कृष्णभक्तिसमन्वितम् ।
ब्रह्मणाश्च शिवस्यापि प्रह्लादस्य तथैव च ॥ 25 ॥
4.133.m: The five Saṃhitās endowed with devotion to Kṛṣṇa / are those of Brahmā, Śiva, and Prahlāda, // 25

4.133.s:
gautamasya kumārasya saṃhitāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .
iti te kathitaṃ sarva krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak .. 26 ..
4.133.d:
गौतमस्य कुमारस्य संहिताः परिकीर्तिताः ।
इति ते कथितं सर्व क्रमेण च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 26 ॥
4.133.m: and the Saṃhitās of Gautama and Kumāra are proclaimed. / Thus everything has been told to you in order and individually. // 26

4.133.s:
astyevaṃ vipulaṃ śāstraṃ mamāpi ca yathāgamam .
uvācedaṃ purāṇaṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale .. 27 ..
4.133.d:
अस्त्येवं विपुलं शास्त्रं ममापि च यथागमम् ।
उवाचेदं पुराणं च गोलोके रासमण्डले ॥ 27 ॥
4.133.m: Such is the vast scripture belonging also to me according to tradition. / In Goloka, within the circle of the rāsa-dance, // 27

4.133.s:
śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsākṣādbrahmāṇaṃ ca svabhaktakam .
brahmā dharma ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ dharmo nārāyaṇaṃ munim .. 28 ..
4.133.d:
श्रीकृष्णो भगवान्साक्षाद्ब्रह्माणं च स्वभक्तकम् ।
ब्रह्मा धर्म च धर्मिष्ठं धर्मो नारायणं मुनिम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.133.m: the blessed Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa himself spoke this Purāṇa to his devotee Brahmā; / Brahmā spoke it to Dharma, most righteous, and Dharma to the sage Nārāyaṇa; // 28

4.133.s:
nārāyaṇo nāradaṃ ca nārado māṃ ca bhaktakam .
ahaṃ tvāṃ ca muniśreṣṭha variṣṭhaṃ kathayāmi tat .. 29 ..
4.133.d:
नारायणो नारदं च नारदो मां च भक्तकम् ।
अहं त्वां च मुनिश्रेष्ठ वरिष्ठं कथयामि तत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.133.m: Nārāyaṇa spoke it to Nārada, and Nārada to me, his devotee. / I shall relate that supreme [work] to you, O best of sages. // 29

4.133.s:
sudarlabhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca brahmavaivartamīpsitam .
yadvṛṇotyeva viśvaughaṃ jīvināṃ paramātmakam .. 30 ..
4.133.d:
सुदर्लभं पुराणं च ब्रह्मवैवर्तमीप्सितम् ।
यद्वृणोत्येव विश्वौघं जीविनां परमात्मकम् ॥ 30 ॥
4.133.m: Very rare is this desired Purāṇa, the Brahmavaivarta, / which encompasses the entire universe, the supreme soul of living beings. // 30

4.133.s:
tadbrahma sākṣirūpaṃ ca karmaṇāmeva karmiṇām .
tadbrahma vivṛtaṃ yatra tadvibhūtimanuttamām .. 31 ..
4.133.d:
तद्ब्रह्म साक्षिरूपं च कर्मणामेव कर्मिणाम् ।
तद्ब्रह्म विवृतं यत्र तद्विभूतिमनुत्तमाम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.133.m: That Brahman is the witnessing form of the deeds of agents; / wherein that Brahman is unfolded along with its unexcelled manifestation, // 31

4.133.s:
tenedaṃ brahmavaivartamityevaṃ ca bidurbudhāḥ .
puṇyapradaṃ purāṇaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ maṅgalapradam .. 32 ..
4.133.d:
तेनेदं ब्रह्मवैवर्तमित्येवं च बिदुर्बुधाः ।
पुण्यप्रदं पुराणं च मङ्गलं मङ्गलप्रदम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.133.m: therefore the wise know it as the Brahmavaivarta. / It is a merit-bestowing Purāṇa, auspicious, granting auspiciousness, // 32

4.133.s:
sugopyaṃ ca rahasyaṃ ca yatra ramyaṃ navaṃ navam .
haribhaktipradaṃ caiva durlabhaṃ haridāsyadam .. 33 ..
4.133.d:
सुगोप्यं च रहस्यं च यत्र रम्यं नवं नवम् ।
हरिभक्तिप्रदं चैव दुर्लभं हरिदास्यदम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.133.m: most secret and profound, delightful, ever-new, / bestowing devotion to Hari, granting rare servitude to Hari, // 33

4.133.s:
sukhadaṃ brahmadaṃ sāraṃ śokasaṃtāpanāśanam .
saritāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā sadyo muktipradā śubhā .. 34 ..
4.133.d:
सुखदं ब्रह्मदं सारं शोकसंतापनाशनम् ।
सरितां च यथा गङ्गा सद्यो मुक्तिप्रदा शुभा ॥ 34 ॥
4.133.m: granting happiness, imparting Brahman, essential, destroying grief and torment. / As the Gaṅgā among rivers is auspicious and immediately grants liberation, // 34

4.133.s:
tirthātāṃ puṣkaraṃ śuddhaṃ yathā kāśī purīṣu ca .
sarveṣu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ sadyo muktipradaṃ śubham .. 35 ..
4.133.d:
तिर्थातां पुष्करं शुद्धं यथा काशी पुरीषु च ।
सर्वेषु भारतं वर्षं सद्यो मुक्तिप्रदं शुभम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.133.m: as Puṣkara is pure among sacred places, and Kāśī among cities, / and as Bhārata among all continents is auspicious, immediately granting liberation; // 35

4.133.s:
yathā sumeruḥ śaileṣu pārijātaṃ ca puṣpataḥ .
patreṣu tulasīpatraṃ vrateṣvekādaśīvratam .. 36 ..
4.133.d:
यथा सुमेरुः शैलेषु पारिजातं च पुष्पतः ।
पत्रेषु तुलसीपत्रं व्रतेष्वेकादशीव्रतम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.133.m: as Sumeru is among mountains, and the pārijāta among flowers, / the leaf of Tulasī among leaves, the Ekādaśī observance among vows; // 36

4.133.s:
vṛkṣeṣu kalpavṛkṣaśca śrīkṛṣṇaśca sureṣu ca .
jñānīndreṣu mahādevo yogīndreṣu gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 37 ..
4.133.d:
वृक्षेषु कल्पवृक्षश्च श्रीकृष्णश्च सुरेषु च ।
ज्ञानीन्द्रेषु महादेवो योगीन्द्रेषु गणेश्वरः ॥ 37 ॥
4.133.m: as the wish-fulfilling tree is among trees, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa among gods, / Mahādeva among masters of knowledge, and Gaṇeśvara among lords of yoga; // 37

4.133.s:
siddhendreṣveva kapilaḥ sūryastejasvināṃ yathā .
sanatkumāro bhagavānvaiṣṇaveṣu yathā'graṇīḥ .. 38 ..
4.133.d:
सिद्धेन्द्रेष्वेव कपिलः सूर्यस्तेजस्विनां यथा ।
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्वैष्णवेषु यथाऽग्रणीः ॥ 38 ॥
4.133.m: as Kapila is among lords of the perfected, and the sun among luminous beings, / and as the blessed Sanatkumāra is foremost among Vaiṣṇavas; // 38

4.133.s:
bhūpeṣu ca yathā rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca dhanuṣmatām .
devīṣu ca yathā durgā mahāpuṇyavatī satī .. 39 ..
4.133.d:
भूपेषु च यथा रामो लक्ष्मणश्च धनुष्मताम् ।
देवीषु च यथा दुर्गा महापुण्यवती सती ॥ 39 ॥
4.133.m: as Rāma is among kings, and Lakṣmaṇa among archers, / as Durgā is among goddesses, the most virtuous and faithful wife; // 39

4.133.s:
prāṇādhikā yathā rādhā kṛṣṇasya preyasīṣu ca .
īśvarīṣu yathā lakṣmīḥ paṇḍiteṣu sarasvatī .. 40 ..
4.133.d:
प्राणाधिका यथा राधा कृष्णस्य प्रेयसीषु च ।
ईश्वरीषु यथा लक्ष्मीः पण्डितेषु सरस्वती ॥ 40 ॥
4.133.m: as Rādhā, dearer than life, is among Kṛṣṇa's beloveds, / Lakṣmī among sovereign goddesses, and Sarasvatī among the learned; // 40

4.133.s:
tathā sarvapurāṇeṣu brahmavaivartameva ca .
nāto diśiṣṭaṃ sukhadaṃ madhuraṃ ca supuṇyadam .. 41 ..
4.133.d:
तथा सर्वपुराणेषु ब्रह्मवैवर्तमेव च ।
नातो दिशिष्टं सुखदं मधुरं च सुपुण्यदम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.133.m: so is the Brahmavaivarta among all the Purāṇas. / None is superior to this, granting happiness, sweet, and bestowing great merit. // 41

4.133.s:
saṃdehabhañjanaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam .
iha loke ca sukhadaṃ supradaṃ sarvasaṃpadām .. 42 ..
4.133.d:
संदेहभञ्जनं चैव पुराणं परिकीर्तितम् ।
इह लोके च सुखदं सुप्रदं सर्वसंपदाम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.133.m: This Purāṇa is proclaimed as the dispeller of doubts; / it gives happiness in this world and easily bestows all treasures. // 42

4.133.s:
śubhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva vighnanighnakaraṃ param .
haridāsyapradaṃ caiva paraloke praharṣadam .. 43 ..
4.133.d:
शुभदं पुण्यदं चैव विघ्ननिघ्नकरं परम् ।
हरिदास्यप्रदं चैव परलोके प्रहर्षदम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.133.m: It grants auspiciousness, confers merit, is supreme in destroying obstacles, / bestows servitude to Hari, and gives immense joy in the other world. // 43

4.133.s:
yajñānāmapi tīrthānāṃ vratānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā .
bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇasyāpi phalaṃ nāsya samānakam .. 44 ..
4.133.d:
यज्ञानामपि तीर्थानां व्रतानां तपसां तथा ।
भुवः प्रदक्षिणस्यापि फलं नास्य समानकम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.133.m: The fruit even of sacrifices, sacred places, vows, austerities, / and circumambulation of the earth is not equal to this. // 44

4.133.s:
caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pāṭhādapi varaṃ phalam .
śrṛṇotīdaṃ purāṇaṃ ca saṃyataśceha putraka .. 45 ..
4.133.d:
चतुर्णामपि वेदानां पाठादपि वरं फलम् ।
श्रृणोतीदं पुराणं च संयतश्चेह पुत्रक ॥ 45 ॥
4.133.m: Its fruit is superior even to the recitation of the four Vedas. / If one hears this Purāṇa with self-control in this world, my son, // 45

4.133.s:
guṇavantaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ putramālabhet .
śrṛṇoti durbhagā cettu saubhāgyaṃ svāmino labhet .. 46 ..
4.133.d:
गुणवन्तं च विद्वांसं वैष्णवं पुत्रमालभेत् ।
श्रृणोति दुर्भगा चेत्तु सौभाग्यं स्वामिनो लभेत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.133.m: one will obtain a virtuous, learned, and Vaiṣṇava son; / and if an unfortunate woman hears it, she obtains good fortune from her husband. // 46

4.133.s:
mṛtavatsā kākavandhyā mahāvandhyā ca pāpinī .
purāṇaśravaṇāllebhe putraṃ ca ciracīvinam .. 47 ..
4.133.d:
मृतवत्सा काकवन्ध्या महावन्ध्या च पापिनी ।
पुराणश्रवणाल्लेभे पुत्रं च चिरचीविनम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.133.m: A woman whose children die, a woman who bears only one child, a completely barren woman, or a sinful woman, / from hearing this Purāṇa, obtains a long-lived son. // 47

4.133.s:
aputro labhate putramabhāryo labhate priyām .
aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ .. 48 ..
4.133.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमभार्यो लभते प्रियाम् ।
अस्पष्टकीर्तिः सुयशा मूर्खो भवति पण्डितः ॥ 48 ॥
4.133.m: A sonless person obtains a son; one without a wife obtains a beloved wife; / one of obscure fame gains renown; a fool becomes learned; // 48

4.133.s:
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt .
bhayānmucyeta bhītastu mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ .. 49 ..
4.133.d:
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् ।
भयान्मुच्येत भीतस्तु मुच्येतापन्न आपदः ॥ 49 ॥
4.133.m: one afflicted with disease is freed from disease; one bound is freed from bondage; / one who is afraid is freed from fear; and one in distress is freed from misfortune. // 49

4.133.s:
araṇye brāntare bhīto dāvāgno mucyate dhruvam .
aghaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca dāridryaṃ rogaṃ śokaṃ ca dāruṇam .. 50 ..
4.133.d:
अरण्ये ब्रान्तरे भीतो दावाग्नो मुच्यते ध्रुवम् ।
अघं कुष्ठं च दारिद्र्यं रोगं शोकं च दारुणम् ॥ 50 ॥
4.133.m: Frightened in the forest wilderness, he is surely freed from forest fire. / Sin, leprosy, poverty, disease, and terrible grief—

4.133.s:
puṇyavānśravaṇādeva naiva jānātyapuṇyavān .
ślokārdha ślokapādaṃ vā yaḥ śṛṇoti susaṃyataḥ .. 51 ..
4.133.d:
पुण्यवान्श्रवणादेव नैव जानात्यपुण्यवान् ।
श्लोकार्ध श्लोकपादं वा यः शृणोति सुसंयतः ॥ 51 ॥
4.133.m: only a meritorious person knows from merely hearing it; an unmeritorious one does not know at all. / One who hears half a verse or a quarter of a verse, self-controlled,

4.133.s:
golakṣadānapuṇyaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
yutuḥkhaḍaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śuddhakāle jitendriyaḥ .. 52 ..
4.133.d:
गोलक्षदानपुण्यं च लभते नात्र संशयः ।
युतुःखडं पुराणं च शुद्धकाले जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 52 ॥
4.133.m: attains the merit of giving a hundred thousand cows; there is no doubt in this. / Having conquered the senses, [hearing] the four-part Purāṇa at a pure time,

4.133.s:
saṃkalpato yaḥ śṛṇoti bhaktyā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām .
yadbālye yaccakaumāre vārdhake yacca yauvane .. 53 ..
4.133.d:
संकल्पतो यः शृणोति भक्त्या दत्त्वा च दक्षिणाम् ।
यद्बाल्ये यच्चकौमारे वार्धके यच्च यौवने ॥ 53 ॥
4.133.m: one who hears it with a vow, with devotion, having given a sacrificial fee, / whatever [sin was done] in childhood, in boyhood, in old age, or in youth,

4.133.s:
koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
ratnanirmāṇayānena dhṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇarūpakam .. 54 ..
4.133.d:
कोटिजन्मार्जितात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ।
रत्ननिर्माणयानेन धृत्वा श्रीकृष्णरूपकम् ॥ 54 ॥
4.133.m: he is freed from the sin accumulated over ten million births; there is no doubt in this. / By a chariot made of jewels, assuming the form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,

4.133.s:
nityaṃ gatvā ca golokaṃ kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ labhedbhūvam .
asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte na bhavettasya pātanam .. 55 ..
4.133.d:
नित्यं गत्वा च गोलोकं कृष्णदास्यं लभेद्भूवम् ।
असंख्यब्रह्मणां पाते न भवेत्तस्य पातनम् ॥ 55 ॥
4.133.m: having gone to eternal Goloka, he will surely attain servitude to Kṛṣṇa. / Even at the demise of countless Brahmās, his fall does not occur.

4.133.s:
samīpe pārṣado bhūtvā sevāṃ ca kurute ciram .
śrutvā ca brahmakhaṇḍaṃ ca susnātaḥ saṃyataḥ śuciḥ .. 56 ..
4.133.d:
समीपे पार्षदो भूत्वा सेवां च कुरुते चिरम् ।
श्रुत्वा च ब्रह्मखण्डं च सुस्नातः संयतः शुचिः ॥ 56 ॥
4.133.m: Becoming an attendant near Him, he performs service for a long time. / And having heard the Brahmakhaṇḍa, well-bathed, restrained, pure,

4.133.s:
pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva phalaṃ tāmbūlameva ca .
bhojayitvā vācakaṃ ca tasmai dadyātsuvarṇakam .. 57 ..
4.133.d:
पायसं पिष्टकं चैव फलं ताम्बूलमेव च ।
भोजयित्वा वाचकं च तस्मै दद्यात्सुवर्णकम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.133.m: having fed the reciter milk-rice, cakes, fruit, and betel, / he should give him gold;

4.133.s:
candanaṃ śuklamālyaṃ ca sūkṣmavastraṃ manoharam .
nivedya vāsudevaṃ ca vācakāya pradīyate .. 58 ..
4.133.d:
चन्दनं शुक्लमाल्यं च सूक्ष्मवस्त्रं मनोहरम् ।
निवेद्य वासुदेवं च वाचकाय प्रदीयते ॥ 58 ॥
4.133.m: sandalwood paste, a white garland, and an exquisite fine garment; / having offered [them] to Vāsudeva, they are given to the reciter.

4.133.s:
śrutvā ca prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ suśrāvyaṃ ca sudhopamam .
bhojayitvā ca dadhyannaṃ tasmai dadyācca ..
kāñcanam .. 59 ..
4.133.d:
श्रुत्वा च प्रकृतेः खण्डं सुश्राव्यं च सुधोपमम् ।
भोजयित्वा च दध्यन्नं तस्मै दद्याच्च ॥
काञ्चनम् ॥ 59 ॥

4.133.s:
savatsāṃ surabhiṃ ramyāṃ dadyādvai bhaktipūrvakam .
śrutvā gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ vighnanāśāya saṃyataḥ .. 60 ..
4.133.d:
सवत्सां सुरभिं रम्यां दद्याद्वै भक्तिपूर्वकम् ।
श्रुत्वा गणपतेः खण्डं विघ्ननाशाय संयतः ॥ 60 ॥
4.133.m: with devotion he should indeed give a lovely cow with her calf. / Having heard the section on Gaṇapati for the destruction of obstacles, restrained,

4.133.s:
svarṇayajñopavītaṃ ca śvetāśvacchatramālyakam .
pradīyate vāyakāya svastikaṃ tilalaḍḍukam .. 61 ..
4.133.d:
स्वर्णयज्ञोपवीतं च श्वेताश्वच्छत्रमाल्यकम् ।
प्रदीयते वायकाय स्वस्तिकं तिललड्डुकम् ॥ 61 ॥
4.133.m: a gold sacred thread, a white horse, an umbrella, and a garland / are given to the reciter, [along with] svastika sweetmeats and sesame sweets,

4.133.s:
paripakvaphalānyeva kāladeśodbhavāni ca .
śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ ca śrutvā bhaktaśca bhaktitaḥ .. 62 ..
4.133.d:
परिपक्वफलान्येव कालदेशोद्भवानि च ।
श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डं च श्रुत्वा भक्तश्च भक्तितः ॥ 62 ॥
4.133.m: and fully ripe fruits produced in that time and region. / And having heard the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa, the devotee, out of devotion,

4.133.s:
vācakāya pradadyācca paraṃ ratnāṅgulīyakam .
sūkṣmavastraṃ ca mālyaṃ ca svarṇakuṇḍalamuttamam .. 63 ..
4.133.d:
वाचकाय प्रदद्याच्च परं रत्नाङ्गुलीयकम् ।
सूक्ष्मवस्त्रं च माल्यं च स्वर्णकुण्डलमुत्तमम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.133.m: should give to the reciter an excellent jewel ring, / fine cloth, a garland, and splendid golden earrings,

4.133.s:
mālyaṃ ca varadolāṃ ca supakvaṃ kṣīrameva ca .
sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātstavanaṃ kurute dhruvam .. 64 ..
4.133.d:
माल्यं च वरदोलां च सुपक्वं क्षीरमेव च ।
सर्वस्वं दक्षिणां दद्यात्स्तवनं कुरुते ध्रुवम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.133.m: a garland, an excellent palanquin, and well-boiled milk; / he should give all his possessions as a sacrificial fee and surely recite praise.

4.133.s:
śatakaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayetparamādarāt .
brahmaṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraniṣṇātaṃ paṇḍitaṃ varam .. 65 ..
4.133.d:
शतकं ब्राह्मणानां च भोजयेत्परमादरात् ।
ब्रह्मणं वैष्णवं शास्त्रनिष्णातं पण्डितं वरम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.133.m: He should feed a hundred brāhmaṇas with the greatest respect. / An excellent brāhmaṇa, a Vaiṣṇava, proficient in the śāstras, learned,

4.133.s:
kurute vācakaṃ śuddhamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet .
śrīkṛṣṇa vimukhādduṣṭānnopadiṣṭācca brāhmaṇāt .. 66 ..
4.133.d:
कुरुते वाचकं शुद्धमन्यथा निष्फलं भवेत् ।
श्रीकृष्ण विमुखाद्दुष्टान्नोपदिष्टाच्च ब्राह्मणात् ॥ 66 ॥
4.133.m: pure, he should appoint as reciter; otherwise it becomes fruitless. / From an evil brāhmaṇa who is averse to Śrī Kṛṣṇa and uninitiated,

4.133.s:
śrīkṛṣṇabhaktiyuktaṃ ca purāṇaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti ca .
bhaktiṃ puṇyaṃ na labhate hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam .. 67 ..
4.133.d:
श्रीकृष्णभक्तियुक्तं च पुराणं यः शृणोति च ।
भक्तिं पुण्यं न लभते हन्ति पुण्यं पुराकृतम् ॥ 67 ॥
4.133.m: if someone hears the Purāṇa endowed with devotion to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, / he does not gain devotion or merit, and it destroys his previously acquired merit.

4.133.s:
śrīkṛṣṇabhaktiyuktācca purāṇaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti ca .
bhaktiṃ puṇyaṃ ca labhate yātyante śrohareḥ padam .. 68 ..
4.133.d:
श्रीकृष्णभक्तियुक्ताच्च पुराणं यः शृणोति च ।
भक्तिं पुण्यं च लभते यात्यन्ते श्रोहरेः पदम् ॥ 68 ॥
4.133.m: And whoever hears the Purāṇa from one endowed with devotion to Śrī Kṛṣṇa / attains devotion and merit, and in the end goes to the realm of Śrī Hari.

4.133.s:
etatte kathitaṃ sarva yacchru taṃ guruvaktrataḥ .
bidāyaṃ dehi viprendra yāmi nārāyaṇāśramam .. 69 ..
4.133.d:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्व यच्छ्रु तं गुरुवक्त्रतः ।
बिदायं देहि विप्रेन्द्र यामि नारायणाश्रमम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.133.m: All this has been told to you as it was heard from the guru's mouth. / Grant leave, best of vipras, I am going to Nārāyaṇa's hermitage.

4.133.s:
dṛṣṭvā viprasamūhaṃ ca namaskartuṃ samāgataḥ .
kathitaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ bhavatāmājñayā param .. 70 ..
4.133.d:
दृष्ट्वा विप्रसमूहं च नमस्कर्तुं समागतः ।
कथितं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं भवतामाज्ञया परम् ॥ 70 ॥
4.133.m: Having seen the assembly of vipras, I came to pay homage. / The supreme Brahmavaivarta has been told by your command.

4.133.s:
namo'stu brāhmaṇebhyaśca kṛṣṇāya paramātmane .
śivāya brahmaṇe nityaṃ gaṇeśāya namo namaḥ .. 71 ..
4.133.d:
नमोऽस्तु ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च कृष्णाय परमात्मने ।
शिवाय ब्रह्मणे नित्यं गणेशाय नमो नमः ॥ 71 ॥
4.133.m: Homage be to the brāhmaṇas and to Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman! / Homage, homage eternally to Śiva, to Brahmā, and to Gaṇeśa!

4.133.s:
kāyena manasā vācā paraṃ bhaktyā divāniśam .
bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ triguṇātparam .. 72 ..
4.133.d:
कायेन मनसा वाचा परं भक्त्या दिवानिशम् ।
भज सत्यं परं ब्रह्म राधेशं त्रिगुणात्परम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.133.m: With body, mind, and speech, with supreme devotion day and night, / worship the true, supreme Brahman, the Lord of Rādhā, beyond the three gunas.

4.133.s:
namo devyai sarasvatyai purāṇagurave namaḥ .
sarvavighnavināśinyai durgādevyai namo namaḥ .. 73 ..
4.133.d:
नमो देव्यै सरस्वत्यै पुराणगुरवे नमः ।
सर्वविघ्नविनाशिन्यै दुर्गादेव्यै नमो नमः ॥ 73 ॥
4.133.m: Homage to goddess Sarasvatī, homage to the guru of the Purāṇas! / Homage, homage to goddess Durgā, the destroyer of all obstacles!

4.133.s:
yuṣmākaṃ pādadmāni dṛṣṭvā puṇyāni śaunaka .
adya siddhāśramaṃ yāmi yatra devo gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 74 ..
4.133.d:
युष्माकं पादद्मानि दृष्ट्वा पुण्यानि शौनक ।
अद्य सिद्धाश्रमं यामि यत्र देवो गणेश्वरः ॥ 74 ॥
4.133.m: Having seen your holy lotus feet, Śaunaka, / today I go to Siddhāśrama, where the god Gaṇeśvara is.

4.133.s:
iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa uttarārdhe nāradanārayaṇasaṃvāde
sūtaśaunakasaṃvāde trayastriṃdaśadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 133 ..
samāpto'yaṃ śrīmadbrahmavaivartapurāṇasthaśrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍasyottarārdhaḥ .
samāptamidaṃ śrīmadbrahmavaipartapurāṇasya caturthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ
śrīmadvyāsamunipraṇītaṃ brahmavaivartapurāṇaṃ ca
4.133.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्ते महापुराणे श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्ड उत्तरार्धे नारदनारयणसंवादे
सूतशौनकसंवादे त्रयस्त्रिंदशधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 133 ॥
समाप्तोऽयं श्रीमद्ब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराणस्थश्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डस्योत्तरार्धः ।
समाप्तमिदं श्रीमद्ब्रह्मवैपर्तपुराणस्य चतुर्थं श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डं
श्रीमद्व्यासमुनिप्रणीतं ब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराणं च
4.133.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-third chapter in the latter half of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the great Purāṇa, the holy Brahmavaivarta, in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the dialogue between Sūta and Śaunaka. 133.
Here ends the latter half of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa belonging to the holy Brahmavaivartapurāṇa. / Concluded is this fourth [section], the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the holy Brahmavaivartapurāṇa, / and the Brahmavaivartapurāṇa composed by the holy sage Vyāsa.

4.134.s:
śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa
1 nāradasya nārāyaṇaṃ prati śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍakathāviṣayakapraśnaḥ, śrīnārāyaṇakṛtā viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayorguṇapraśaṃsā ca..65 ślokāḥ.
4.134.d:
श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्ड
1 नारदस्य नारायणं प्रति श्रीकृष्णजन्मखंडकथाविषयकप्रश्नः, श्रीनारायणकृता विष्णुवैष्णवयोर्गुणप्रशंसा च॥65 श्लोकाः।
4.134.m: Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa: / 1. Nārada’s question to Nārāyaṇa regarding the story of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa, and the praise of the qualities of Viṣṇu and Vaiṣṇavas spoken by Śrī Nārāyaṇa; 65 verses.

4.134.s: 2 yato harergopaveṣeṇa gokulāgamanaṃ tathā yena rādhā gopālikā jātā tatkāraṇakathanaṃ, nāradasya śrīdāmno rādhāyāśca kalaha viṣayakapraśnaḥ, ratnamaṃḍape virajāsaktaṃ śrīhariṃ sakhīmukhācchrutvā kupitāyā rādhikāyā ratnamaṃḍapagamanaṃ, rādhāśabdaśravaṇato hareradarśanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītyā virajayā kṛtaṃ prāṇatyāgapūrvaka nadīrūpadhāraṇaṃ ca 68
4.134.d: 2 यतो हरेर्गोपवेषेण गोकुलागमनं तथा येन राधा गोपालिका जाता तत्कारणकथनं, नारदस्य श्रीदाम्नो राधायाश्च कलह विषयकप्रश्नः, रत्नमंडपे विरजासक्तं श्रीहरिं सखीमुखाच्छ्रुत्वा कुपिताया राधिकाया रत्नमंडपगमनं, राधाशब्दश्रवणतो हरेरदर्शनं दृष्ट्वा भीत्या विरजया कृतं प्राणत्यागपूर्वक नदीरूपधारणं च 68
4.134.m: 2. The reason why Hari came to Gokula in the dress of a cowherd and whereby Rādhā became a cowherdess; Nārada's question regarding the dispute between Śrīdāman and Rādhā; Rādhikā, angered after hearing from her friend's mouth that Śrī Hari was attached to Virajā in the gem-pavilion, goes to the gem-pavilion; Virajā, seeing the disappearance of Hari upon hearing the sound of Rādhā, out of fear abandoning her life-breaths and assuming the form of a river; 68 [verses].

4.134.s: 3 saptasamudrotpattiḥ, kopamaṃdiradvāri śrīdāmnā sahāgataṃ hariṃ prati punaḥ punā rādhoktiḥ, hariṃ nirgamayitumājñaptānāṃ sakhīnāṃ taṃ prati vacanāni rādhāṃ prati śrīharimahattvavarṇanātmakaṃ śrīdāmno vacanaṃ, rādhāśrīdāmnoḥ parasparaṃ śāpaḥ,śāpaduḥkhākulau rādhā śrīdāmānau prati samādhānakārakaṃ śrīharivacanaṃ ca. 117
4.134.d: 3 सप्तसमुद्रोत्पत्तिः, कोपमंदिरद्वारि श्रीदाम्ना सहागतं हरिं प्रति पुनः पुना राधोक्तिः, हरिं निर्गमयितुमाज्ञप्तानां सखीनां तं प्रति वचनानि राधां प्रति श्रीहरिमहत्त्ववर्णनात्मकं श्रीदाम्नो वचनं, राधाश्रीदाम्नोः परस्परं शापः,शापदुःखाकुलौ राधा श्रीदामानौ प्रति समाधानकारकं श्रीहरिवचनं च। 117
4.134.m: 3. The origin of the seven oceans; Rādhā's repeated words to Hari who came with Śrīdāman to the door of her chamber of anger; the words of the friends commanded to expel Hari addressed to Him; Śrīdāman's words to Rādhā describing the greatness of Śrī Hari; the mutual cursing of Rādhā and Śrīdāman; and the words of Śrī Hari providing consolation to Rādhā and Śrīdāman distressed by the sorrow of the curse; 117 [verses].

4.134.s: 4 suraiḥ saha śaraṇāgatāṃ dharāṃ prati brahmaṇā vacanam, brahmapraśnatastasmai keṣāṃ bhāro me'sahyastaddharayā kathanam, dharayā surasaṃghaiśca saha śivalokaṃ gatena brahmaṇā śivāya dharāvṛttakathanam, sasuradharāṇāṃ brahmeśadharmāṇāṃ vaikuṃṭhe gamanam, brahmeśadharmakṛtaṃ śrīharistotrama, śrīharyājñayā sarvadevānāṃ golokagamanaṃ golokavarṇanaṃ ca 180
4.134.d: 4 सुरैः सह शरणागतां धरां प्रति ब्रह्मणा वचनम्, ब्रह्मप्रश्नतस्तस्मै केषां भारो मेऽसह्यस्तद्धरया कथनम्, धरया सुरसंघैश्च सह शिवलोकं गतेन ब्रह्मणा शिवाय धरावृत्तकथनम्, ससुरधराणां ब्रह्मेशधर्माणां वैकुंठे गमनम्, ब्रह्मेशधर्मकृतं श्रीहरिस्तोत्रम, श्रीहर्याज्ञया सर्वदेवानां गोलोकगमनं गोलोकवर्णनं च 180
4.134.m: 4. Brahmā's speech to the Earth who had sought refuge along with the gods; upon Brahmā's question, the Earth's explanation to him of whose burden was unbearable to her; Brahmā, having gone with the Earth and the hosts of gods to Śivaloka, reports the Earth's condition to Śiva; the departure of Brahmā, Īśa, and Dharma, together with the gods and the Earth, to Vaikuṇṭha; the hymn of praise to Śrī Hari composed by Brahmā, Īśa, and Dharma; and by Śrī Hari's command, the departure of all the gods to Goloka, and the description of Goloka; 180 [verses].

4.134.s: 5 rādhāmaṃdiraṣoḍaśadvārāṇāṃ varṇanam, ṣoḍaśadvārātikramottaraṃ rādhābhyaṃtaragṛhe devānāṃ gamanaṃ, rādhāmaṃdiravarṇanam, devai rādhāmaṃdire śrīkṛṣṇatejaḥsvarūpasya darśanaṃ, brahmeśadharmakṛtaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastavarājaḥ, tatpaṭhanaphalakathanaṃ ca 126
4.134.d: 5 राधामंदिरषोडशद्वाराणां वर्णनम्, षोडशद्वारातिक्रमोत्तरं राधाभ्यंतरगृहे देवानां गमनं, राधामंदिरवर्णनम्, देवै राधामंदिरे श्रीकृष्णतेजःस्वरूपस्य दर्शनं, ब्रह्मेशधर्मकृतः श्रीकृष्णस्तवराजः, तत्पठनफलकथनं च 126
4.134.m: 5. The description of the sixteen gates of Rādhā's palace; the gods' entering into Rādhā's inner chamber after passing through the sixteen gates; the description of Rādhā's palace; the sight by the gods of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's form of light in Rādhā's palace; the royal hymn of praise to Śrī Kṛṣṇa composed by Brahmā, Īśa, and Dharma, and the explanation of the fruit of reciting it; 126 [verses].

4.134.s: 6 pūrvadṛṣṭatejaḥsvarūpamadhye devairālokitāyāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtervarṇanama, surakṛtastavatuṣṭena śrīkṛṣṇena devebhyo'bhayadānam, pṛthivyāmavataraṇārthaṃ rādhādigolokasthajanān prati kṛṣṇasyājñāvacanam, golokasamāgatānāṃ nārāyaṇaviṣṇusaṃkarṣaṇānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇadehe līnatā pṛthivyāṃ svasvāṃśenāvataraṇārthaṃ sakaladevatābhyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasyājñā, kena kutra kiṃnāmnāvataraṇaṃ kartavyamiti brahmapraśnataḥ kṛṣṇena tatkathanam, bhāvivirahakātarayā rudatīṃ rādhāṃ prati śrīkṛṣṇasya bodhavacanam , kṛṣṇājñayā sakaladevatānāṃ svasvasthāne gamanam ,kṛṣṇājñayā golokādgopagopīgaṇaiḥ saha rādhāyā gokule gamanam, śrīharermathurāgamanaṃ ca 278
4.134.d: 6 पूर्वदृष्टतेजःस्वरूपमध्ये देवैरालोकितायाः कृष्णमूर्तेर्वर्णनम, सुरकृतस्तवतुष्टेन श्रीकृष्णेन देवेभ्योऽभयदानम्, पृथिव्यामवतरणार्थं राधादिगोलोकस्थजनान् प्रति कृष्णस्याज्ञावचनम्, गोलोकसमागतानां नारायणविष्णुसंकर्षणानां श्रीकृष्णदेहे लीनता पृथिव्यां स्वस्वांशेनावतरणार्थं सकलदेवताभ्यः श्रीकृष्णस्याज्ञा, केन कुत्र किंनाम्नावतरणं कर्तव्यमिति ब्रह्मप्रश्नतः कृष्णेन तत्कथनम्, भाविविरहकातरया रुदतीं राधां प्रति श्रीकृष्णस्य बोधवचनम् , कृष्णाज्ञया सकलदेवतानां स्वस्वस्थाने गमनम् ,कृष्णाज्ञया गोलोकाद्गोपगोपीगणैः सह राधाया गोकुले गमनम्, श्रीहरेर्मथुरागमनं च 278
4.134.m: 6. Description of Kṛṣṇa's form observed by the gods within the previously seen mass of radiance; Śrī Kṛṣṇa, pleased by the hymn composed by the gods, grants freedom from fear to the gods; Kṛṣṇa's command to the residents of Goloka, including Rādhā, to descend to the earth; the merging of Nārāyaṇa, Viṣṇu, and Saṃkarṣaṇa, who had arrived at Goloka, into Śrī Kṛṣṇa's body; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's command to all the deities to descend to the earth with their respective portions; Kṛṣṇa's explanation in response to Brahmā's question as to who should descend, where, and under what name; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's words of consolation to Rādhā, who is weeping in distress at the impending separation; the departure of all the deities to their respective abodes by Kṛṣṇa's command; the departure of Rādhā from Goloka to Gokula along with the hosts of cowherds and milkmaids by Kṛṣṇa's command; and Śrī Hari's arrival at Mathurā. 278

4.134.m: 7. The story of the birth of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 132

4.134.m: 8. An account of the ritual regulations for the vow and fast of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Janmāṣṭamī. 86

4.134.s: 9 nāradapraśnato nārāyaṇena nandayaśodārohiṇīnāṃ janmāṃtaravṛttakathanam baladevajanmākhyānam, nandaputrotsavakathanaṃ ca. 80
4.134.d: 9 नारदप्रश्नतो नारायणेन नन्दयशोदारोहिणीनां जन्मांतरवृत्तकथनम् बलदेवजन्माख्यानम्, नन्दपुत्रोत्सवकथनं च। 80
4.134.m: 9. Nārāyaṇa relates the past life accounts of Nanda, Yaśodā, and Rohiṇī in response to Nārada's inquiry; the story of the birth of Baladeva; and an account of Nanda's celebration for the birth of his son. 80

4.134.s: 10 kaṃsapreraṇayā kṛṣṇaṃ haṃtuṃ nandagṛhamāgatāyāḥ pūtanāyāḥ kṛṣṇakṛtastanapānena mokṣaḥ pūtanāyā janmāntarakathanaṃ ca 46
4.134.d: 10 कंसप्रेरणया कृष्णं हंतुं नन्दगृहमागतायाः पूतनायाः कृष्णकृतस्तनपानेन मोक्षः पूतनाया जन्मान्तरकथनं च 46
4.134.m: 10. Pūtanā, having arrived at Nanda's house to kill Kṛṣṇa at the instigation of Kaṃsa, attains liberation through Kṛṣṇa's suckling of her breast; and the account of Pūtanā's previous life. 46

4.134.s: 11 tṛṣṇāvartadaityavadhaḥ tajjanmāṃtaravṛttakathanaṃ ca. 35
4.134.d: 11 तृष्णावर्तदैत्यवधः तज्जन्मांतरवृत्तकथनं च। 35
4.134.m: 11. The slaying of the demon Tṛṇāvarta; and the account of his previous life. 35

4.134.s: 12 śakaṭāsurabhaṃjanam, yoganidroktakavacanyāsaśca. 42
4.134.d: 12 शकटासुरभंजनम्, योगनिद्रोक्तकवचन्यासश्च। 42
4.134.m: 12. The breaking of Śakaṭāsura; and the assignment of the armour proclaimed by Yoganidrā. 42

4.134.s: 13 vasudevakṛtaprārthanayā śrīkṛṣṇasya nāmakaraṇādisaṃskārakaraṇārthaṃ gargasya naṃdagṛhe gamanam gargeṇa svāgamanaprayojanasyaśrīkṛṣṇanāmārthasya tathā purā śivamukhācchrutasya golokavṛttasya ca naṃdayaśodābhyāṃ kathanam ,gargājñayā naṃdena kṛṣṇasya nāmakaraṇādisaṃskaraṇam, gargakṛtaśrīkṛṣṇastotram, gargasya svagṛhagamanam 247
4.134.d: 13 वसुदेवकृतप्रार्थनया श्रीकृष्णस्य नामकरणादिसंस्कारकरणार्थं गर्गस्य नंदगृहे गमनम् गर्गेण स्वागमनप्रयोजनस्यश्रीकृष्णनामार्थस्य तथा पुरा शिवमुखाच्छ्रुतस्य गोलोकवृत्तस्य च नंदयशोदाभ्यां कथनम् ,गर्गाज्ञया नंदेन कृष्णस्य नामकरणादिसंस्करणम्, गर्गकृतश्रीकृष्णस्तोत्रम्, गर्गस्य स्वगृहगमनम् 247
4.134.m: 13. At the request made by Vasudeva, Garga's arrival at Nanda's house to perform the naming and other rites of passage for Śrī Kṛṣṇa; Garga explains the purpose of his arrival, the meaning of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's name, and the account of Goloka previously heard from Śiva's mouth to Nanda and Yaśodā; by Garga's instruction, Nanda performs the naming and other rites of passage for Kṛṣṇa; the hymn to Śrī Kṛṣṇa composed by Garga; and Garga's return to his own home. 247

4.134.s: 14 yamalārjunabhaṃjanaṃ, nalakūbaramokṣaḥ, vṛkṣākhyānaṃ ca...54
4.134.d: 14 यमलार्जुनभंजनं, नलकूबरमोक्षः, वृक्षाख्यानं च॥.54
4.134.m: 14. The breaking of the Yamalārjuna trees; the liberation of Nalakūbara; and the account of the trees. 54

4.134.s: 15 bhāṃḍīravane rādhākṛṣṇayorvivāhaḥ, navasaṃgamaprastāvaśca 178
4.134.d: 15 भांडीरवने राधाकृष्णयोर्विवाहः, नवसंगमप्रस्तावश्च 178
4.134.m: 15. The wedding of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in the Bhāṇḍīra forest; and the narrative of their first union. 178

4.134.s: 16 bakāsuravadhaḥ, pralaṃbāsuravadhaḥ, keśidaityavadhaḥ eteṣāṃ janmāntaravṛttāṃtaḥ, pārvatyā kṛtasya traimāsikanāmavratasyavidhiḥ nandājñayā sarvavrajajanānāṃ vṛṃdāvane gamanaṃ ca. 178
4.134.d: 16 बकासुरवधः, प्रलंबासुरवधः, केशिदैत्यवधः एतेषां जन्मान्तरवृत्तांतः, पार्वत्या कृतस्य त्रैमासिकनामव्रतस्यविधिः नन्दाज्ञया सर्वव्रजजनानां वृंदावने गमनं च। 178

4.134.m: 104 The arrival of gods headed by Brahmā to behold Dvārakā; the description of Dvārakā; by the power of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's will, the sudden arrival of Yādavas headed by Ugrasena, as well as gods, munis, siddhas, ṛṣis, kings, and men at the root of a banyan tree near Dvārakā; the conversation between Kṛṣṇa and Ugrasena for entering Dvārakā; and, upon entering Dvārakā by Kṛṣṇa's command, the festival of the royal consecration of Ugrasena ... 99

4.134.d: 105 रुक्मिण्युद्वाहाख्यानम् तत्र रुक्मिणीसौंदर्यप्रशंसा, भीष्मकस्य सुतमंत्रिपुरोहितादिजनान् प्रति रुक्मिण्यर्थं वरवरणप्रश्नः रुक्मिणी श्रीकृष्णाय देयेति तन्महत्ववर्णनपूर्वकं शतानंदस्यवचनम्, तद्वचनतुष्टेन भीष्मकेण कृतो भूरत्नादिदानतः शतानंदस्य सन्मानः, तद्वचनरुष्टस्य रुक्मिणः पितरं प्रति शिशुपालाय कन्या देयेति विप्रकृष्णभर्त्सनपूर्वकं वचनम्, सर्वत्रामंत्रणपत्रिकाप्रेषणम्, कृष्णाह्वानार्थं भीष्मकेण विप्रद्वारागूढप्रेषितपत्रिकायादर्शनेन रामकृष्णोग्रसेनादीनां कुंडिनयात्रार्थं सज्जता च ॥॥॥ 86
4.134.m: 105 The account of the wedding of Rukmiṇī: therein, the praise of Rukmiṇī's beauty; Bhīṣmaka's inquiry to his sons, ministers, family priest, and others regarding the selection of a bridegroom for Rukmiṇī; Śatānanda's speech declaring that Rukmiṇī should be given to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by an account of his greatness; the honour paid to Śatānanda by Bhīṣmaka, pleased with his speech, by bestowing land, gems, and the like; the speech of Rukmin, who was angered by those words, addressing his father to say that the maiden should be given to Śiśupāla, accompanied by rebukes against the brāhmaṇa and Kṛṣṇa; the sending of invitation letters everywhere; and, seeing the letter sent secretly by Bhīṣmaka through a brāhmaṇa to summon Kṛṣṇa, the preparation of Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, Ugrasena, and the others to journey to Kuṇḍina ... 86

4.134.d: 106 तत्समय एव रेवतीबलरामयोर्विवाहः ततः सपरिवारस्य कृष्णस्य कुंडिनपुरांतिके गमनम्, तदागमनकुपितानां रुक्मिशाल्वशिशुपालानां कृष्णोपहासरूपं वचनं च ॥। 27
4.134.m: 106 At that very time, the marriage of Revatī and Balarāma; then the departure of Kṛṣṇa accompanied by his retinue to the vicinity of the city of Kuṇḍina; and the mocking words directed at Kṛṣṇa by Rukmin, Śālva, and Śiśupāla, who were infuriated by his arrival ... 27

4.134.m: 107. The crushing of the wicked Rukmin, Śālva, and others by Balabhadra, who was enraged by their mockery; the hospitality shown by Bhīṣmaka through gifts of garments, food, and the like to the bridegroom's party, accompanied by Kṛṣṇa, after they were led into the city by Śatānanda; the performance of the consecration of the familial deity and other rites by Vasudeva and Bhīṣmaka; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's arrival at the wedding pavilion; the description of the pavilion; Bhīṣmaka's words in praise of the brahmins and others who had gathered to witness Kṛṣṇa's wedding; and the hymn of praise to Śrī Kṛṣṇa composed by Bhīṣmaka. 101 / 108. The bestowal of Rukmiṇī according to the prescribed rite for giving away a maiden to Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 14

4.134.m: 109. The auspicious celebration, including the adorning of the bride and groom, performed by Rukmiṇī's mother and others after the giving of the maiden; the words of gentle mockery addressed to Śrī Kṛṣṇa by Pārvatī, Sarasvatī, Lopāmudrā, and other wives of the gods and sages; the offering of food to all; the words of the mother to Rukmiṇī as Śrī Kṛṣṇa, along with his bride, prepared to depart for Dvārakā; the narration of the dowry given by Bhīṣmaka; and the auspicious festivities, such as the bride entering her new home, after their arrival in Dvārakā. 49

4.134.m: 110. Yaśodā's request to Śrī Kṛṣṇa for knowledge; the visit of Yaśodā and Nanda to Rādhā at Kṛṣṇa's command; the description of Rādhā's condition at that time; and the dialogue of Rādhā with Yaśodā and Nanda. 39

4.134.m: 111. Rādhā's instruction on devotion and knowledge given to Yaśodā, as well as the granting of a boon, accompanied by the explanation of the etymology of her own name. 63

4.134.m: 114. The episode of the abduction of Ūṣā: therein, the dialogue of Aniruddha with Ūṣā, whom he had seen in a dream; Kṛṣṇa's words to the frightened women, Devakī, Rukmiṇī, and others, on seeing Aniruddha's condition arising from separation from Ūṣā; the manner of the dream shown to Ūṣā by Kṛṣṇa; Citralekhā's speech to Ūṣā; the conversation between Gaṇeśa and Śiva; the bringing of Aniruddha to Ūṣā by Citralekhā; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's march to Śoṇitapura; and the amorous sport of Ūṣā and Aniruddha. 94

4.134.m: 115. 4.134.d: 118 बाणस्कंदादिगणवेष्टिताय शिवाय मणिभद्रदत्तेन कृष्णागमनवार्तायाः कथनम्, बाणासुरसंरक्षणार्थं पार्वतीस्कदगणेशादीन् प्रति शिवोक्तिः बाणेन सोषोऽनिरुद्धः श्रीकृष्णाय देय इति बुद्ध्या कृष्णमहत्त्ववर्णनरूपं पार्वत्या वचनं च॥ 40
4.134.m: 118. The report of Kṛṣṇa's arrival brought by Maṇibhadradatta to Śiva, who was surrounded by Bāṇa, Skanda, and the hosts of attendants; Śiva's address to Pārvatī, Skanda, Gaṇeśa, and the others for the protection of the demon Bāṇa; and Pārvatī's speech describing Kṛṣṇa's greatness, advising that Bāṇa should give Aniruddha along with Ūṣā to Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 40

4.134.s: 119 gauryuktyanumodanātmakaṃ śivavacanam, tatsamaye tatsabhāyāṃ prāptasya baleḥ śivakṛtā stutiḥ śivaṃ prati balivacanam, balidaityakṛtaṃ śivastotraṃ, stotratuṣṭena bhagavatā balaye'bhayadānam, stotrapaṭhanaphalakathanaṃ ca... ... -.... 75
4.134.d: 119 गौर्युक्त्यनुमोदनात्मकं शिववचनम्, तत्समये तत्सभायां प्राप्तस्य बलेः शिवकृता स्तुतिः शिवं प्रति बलिवचनम्, बलिदैत्यकृतं शिवस्तोत्रं, स्तोत्रतुष्टेन भगवता बलयेऽभयदानम्, स्तोत्रपठनफलकथनं च॥॥॥ -॥॥ 75
4.134.m: 119. Śiva's speech agreeing with Gaurī's words; the praise offered by Bali, who arrived in the assembly at that moment, to Śiva; Bali's words to Śiva; the hymn of praise to Śiva composed by the Daitya Bali; the granting of fearlessness to Bali by the Lord, who was pleased with the hymn; and the statement of the fruit of reciting the hymn. 75

4.134.s: 120 kṛṣṇena śivaṃ prati dūtapreṣaṇam śivaṃ prati kṛṣṇadūtasya vacanam, bāṇaṃ prati pārvatyuktiḥ, bāṇakṛpṇayoryuddhaprakāraḥ, śivena śara ṇa prāpitāya bāṇāya kṛṣṇenājarāmaratvavaradānaṃ,śivājñayā bāṇakṛta ūṣānikaddhavivāhotsavaśca....... 79
4.134.d: 120 कृष्णेन शिवं प्रति दूतप्रेषणम् शिवं प्रति कृष्णदूतस्य वचनम्, बाणं प्रति पार्वत्युक्तिः, बाणकृप्णयोर्युद्धप्रकारः, शिवेन शर ण प्रापिताय बाणाय कृष्णेनाजरामरत्ववरदानं,शिवाज्ञया बाणकृत ऊषानिकद्धविवाहोत्सवश्च॥॥॥। 79
4.134.m: 120. Kṛṣṇa's dispatching of a messenger to Śiva; the words of Kṛṣṇa's messenger to Śiva; Pārvatī's speech to Bāṇa; the manner of the battle between Bāṇa and Kṛṣṇa; the granting of the boon of agelessness and immortality by Kṛṣṇa to Bāṇa, who had taken refuge through Śiva; and the wedding festival of Ūṣā and Aniruddha celebrated by Bāṇa at Śiva's command. 79

4.134.s: 121 sudharmasabhāsthitāya kṛṣṇāya vipreṇa śṛgālavāsudevasya saṃdeśakathanam, śṛgālanagare kṛṣṇasya gamanam, śṛgālakṛṣṇayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇapūrvakaḥ samaraḥ, śṛgālamokṣaṇaṃ ca. .. 52
4.134.d: 121 सुधर्मसभास्थिताय कृष्णाय विप्रेण शृगालवासुदेवस्य संदेशकथनम्, शृगालनगरे कृष्णस्य गमनम्, शृगालकृष्णयोः संभाषणपूर्वकः समरः, शृगालमोक्षणं च॥। 52
4.134.m: 121. The delivery by a brahmin of the message of the Jackal-Vāsudeva to Kṛṣṇa seated in the Sudharmā assembly; Kṛṣṇa's journey to the city of Śṛgāla; the battle preceded by a dialogue between Śṛgāla and Kṛṣṇa; and the liberation of Śṛgāla. 52

4.134.s: 122 nāradapraśnato nārāyaṇena syamaṃtakopākhyānakathanam. -.... 32
4.134.d: 122 नारदप्रश्नतो नारायणेन स्यमंतकोपाख्यानकथनम्। -॥॥ 32
4.134.m: 122. The narration of the episode of the Syamantaka jewel by Nārāyaṇa in response to Nārada's inquiry. 32

4.134.s: 123 nāradasya nārāyaṇaṃ prati gaṇeśapūjāvyākhyānapraśnaḥ, siddhāśrame sadārāṇāṃ devasiddhayogimuninareṃdragopayādavādīnāṃ gaṇeśapūjanārthaṃ siddhaśrame āgamanam, tatra rādhākṛtaṃ yathāvidhigaṇeśapūjanaṃ ca.... - 60
4.134.d: 123 नारदस्य नारायणं प्रति गणेशपूजाव्याख्यानप्रश्नः, सिद्धाश्रमे सदाराणां देवसिद्धयोगिमुनिनरेंद्रगोपयादवादीनां गणेशपूजनार्थं सिद्धश्रमे आगमनम्, तत्र राधाकृतं यथाविधिगणेशपूजनं च॥॥ - 60
4.134.m: 123. Nārada's inquiry to Nārāyaṇa regarding the exposition of the worship of Gaṇeśa; the arrival at Siddhāśrama of the gods, Siddhas, yogins, sages, kings, cowherds, and Yādavas along with their wives to worship Gaṇeśa; and the worship of Gaṇeśa performed there by Rādhā according to the prescribed rules. 60

4.134.s: 124 pūjanatuṣṭagaṇeśasya rādhāṃ prati tatstutipūrvakaṃ vacanam, siddhāśramarakṣakaśivadūtena brahmaśivakṛṣṇādīnprati rādhākṛtapūjanasya kathanam, sarvajanairgaṇeśasya pūjanam pārvatyā rādhāyai varapradānam, śrīdāmaśāpamuktarādhāyāḥ pārvatyājñayā sakhībhiḥ suveṣakaraṇam, sarvajanapraśnataḥ kṛṣṇena rādhāyāḥ pūrvavṛttasya kathanam, tadā'khilajanadṛṣṭāyā rādhārūpasthitervarṇanam, brahmeśaśeṣādikṛtarādhāstotraṃ ca .. .. ... 111
4.134.d: 124 पूजनतुष्टगणेशस्य राधां प्रति तत्स्तुतिपूर्वकं वचनम्, सिद्धाश्रमरक्षकशिवदूतेन ब्रह्मशिवकृष्णादीन्प्रति राधाकृतपूजनस्य कथनम्, सर्वजनैर्गणेशस्य पूजनम् पार्वत्या राधायै वरप्रदानम्, श्रीदामशापमुक्तराधायाः पार्वत्याज्ञया सखीभिः सुवेषकरणम्, सर्वजनप्रश्नतः कृष्णेन राधायाः पूर्ववृत्तस्य कथनम्, तदाऽखिलजनदृष्टाया राधारूपस्थितेर्वर्णनम्, ब्रह्मेशशेषादिकृतराधास्तोत्रं च ॥ ॥ ॥। 111
4.134.m: 124. The address of Gaṇeśa, pleased with the worship, to Rādhā, preceded by his praise of her; the report of Rādhā's worship given to Brahmā, Śiva, Kṛṣṇa, and others by the messenger of Śiva who guarded Siddhāśrama; the worship of Gaṇeśa by all the people; the granting of a boon to Rādhā by Pārvatī; the adorning of Rādhā, now freed from Śrīdāman's curse, by her female companions at Pārvatī's command; the narration of Rādhā's past deeds by Kṛṣṇa upon the inquiry of all the people; the description of the beauty and presence of Rādhā as seen then by all; and the hymn of praise to Rādhā composed by Brahmā, Īśa, Śeṣa, and others. 111

4.134.s: 125 śivabrahmasiddhamunīṃdrān prati devakīvasudevayoḥ praśnaḥ, vasudevaṃ prati śivoktiḥ, śivājñayā vasudevakṛto rājasūyayajñaḥ, sanatkumārājñayā yajñapūrtyarthaṃ vasudevena sarvasvadānaṃ ca .. ... 54
4.134.d: 125 शिवब्रह्मसिद्धमुनींद्रान् प्रति देवकीवसुदेवयोः प्रश्नः, वसुदेवं प्रति शिवोक्तिः, शिवाज्ञया वसुदेवकृतो राजसूययज्ञः, सनत्कुमाराज्ञया यज्ञपूर्त्यर्थं वसुदेवेन सर्वस्वदानं च ॥ ॥। 54
4.134.m: 125. The inquiry of Devakī and Vasudeva to Śiva, Brahmā, and the foremost Siddhas and sages; Śiva's speech to Vasudeva; the Rājasūya sacrifice performed by Vasudeva at Śiva's command; and the giving away of all his possessions by Vasudeva at the command of Sanatkumāra to complete the sacrifice. 54

4.134.s: 126 siddhāśramādrukmiṇyādistrībhiḥ saha kṛṣṇasyāṃśato dvārakāyāṃ gamanam, tataḥ pūrṇasya kṛṣṇasya nandādivrajajanānyathocitaṃ vacanam, pitroranumatena kṛṣṇasya rādhāsthānagamanam, kṛṣṇadarśanatuṣṭayā rādhayākṛtaḥ praṇāmapūrvakaḥ kṛṣṇastavaḥ, ratnasiṃhāsanopaviṣṭasya rādhākṛṣṇasya sakhīkṛtasevāyāḥ prakāraḥ, rādhāyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prati kuśalapraśnādivacanam, śrīkṛṣṇena rādhāyai ādhyātmikakathanaṃ ca. ... .. ..103
4.134.d: 126 सिद्धाश्रमाद्रुक्मिण्यादिस्त्रीभिः सह कृष्णस्यांशतो द्वारकायां गमनम्, ततः पूर्णस्य कृष्णस्य नन्दादिव्रजजनान्यथोचितं वचनम्, पित्रोरनुमतेन कृष्णस्य राधास्थानगमनम्, कृष्णदर्शनतुष्टया राधयाकृतः प्रणामपूर्वकः कृष्णस्तवः, रत्नसिंहासनोपविष्टस्य राधाकृष्णस्य सखीकृतसेवायाः प्रकारः, राधायाः कृष्णं प्रति कुशलप्रश्नादिवचनम्, श्रीकृष्णेन राधायै आध्यात्मिककथनं च॥॥ ॥ ॥103
4.134.m: 126. Kṛṣṇa's journey with Rukmiṇī and the other women from Siddhāśrama to Dvārakā by his portion; then, of the complete Kṛṣṇa, words as appropriate to Nanda and the other people of Vraja; with the permission of his parents, Kṛṣṇa's going to Rādhā's abode; the hymn of praise to Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by prostrations, performed by Rādhā who was pleased at the sight of Kṛṣṇa; the manner of the service performed by the female companions to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa seated on a jewel-throne; Rādhā's words of greeting and enquiry to Kṛṣṇa; and Śrī Kṛṣṇa's discourse on spiritual wisdom to Rādhā. ... 103

4.134.s: 127 rādhākṛṣṇayoḥ śṛṅgārakathanam, śrīkṛṣṇena rādhayā saha nānāvanopavanārāmaśailadroṇīsamudranadanadīsarodvīpapuragrāmādiṣu vihārakaraṇam, punaḥ kṛṣṇasya rādhayā saha gokulāgamanam vrajajanakṛṣṇasaṃmalenasyādbhutaprakāraḥ . ... 45
4.134.d: 127 राधाकृष्णयोः शृङ्गारकथनम्, श्रीकृष्णेन राधया सह नानावनोपवनारामशैलद्रोणीसमुद्रनदनदीसरोद्वीपपुरग्रामादिषु विहारकरणम्, पुनः कृष्णस्य राधया सह गोकुलागमनम् व्रजजनकृष्णसंमलेनस्याद्भुतप्रकारः ॥॥ 45
4.134.m: 127. The account of the amorous love of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's sporting with Rādhā in various forests, groves, gardens, mountain valleys, oceans, rivers, lakes, islands, cities, villages, and other places; Kṛṣṇa's return again with Rādhā to Gokula; the wondrous manner of the meeting between Kṛṣṇa and the people of Vraja. ... 45

4.134.s: 128 bhāṃḍīravane vrajajanasamakṣaṃ naṃdaṃ bodhayatā kṛṣṇena kalidoṣāṇāṃ nirūpaṇam, akasmātprāptenādbhutarathena rādhādisarvagopīnāṃ goloke gamanaṃ ca . .. ... 53
4.134.d: 128 भांडीरवने व्रजजनसमक्षं नंदं बोधयता कृष्णेन कलिदोषाणां निरूपणम्, अकस्मात्प्राप्तेनाद्भुतरथेन राधादिसर्वगोपीनां गोलोके गमनं च ॥॥॥ 53
4.134.m: 128. In the Bhāṇḍīra forest, in the presence of the people of Vraja, while instructing Nanda, Kṛṣṇa's description of the evils of the Kali age; and the journey of all the cowherd women, beginning with Rādhā, to Goloka by means of a wondrous chariot that arrived suddenly. ... 53

4.134.s: 129 punaḥ kṛṣṇena gokulajanānāṃ samāśvāsanam , bhāṃḍīravane brahmeśādibhiḥ kṛtā kṛṣṇasya prārthanā, brahmaśāpena yādavanidhanaṃ, dvārakālayādivṛttam pāṃḍavamokṣaṇam,kaliprāptibhītyā rudatīrjāhnavyādipuṇyanadīḥ prati samādhānātmakaṃ kṛṣṇavacanam, śrīkṛṣṇasya nijadhāmagamanam .. . 111
4.134.d: 129 पुनः कृष्णेन गोकुलजनानां समाश्वासनम् , भांडीरवने ब्रह्मेशादिभिः कृता कृष्णस्य प्रार्थना, ब्रह्मशापेन यादवनिधनं, द्वारकालयादिवृत्तम् पांडवमोक्षणम्,कलिप्राप्तिभीत्या रुदतीर्जाह्नव्यादिपुण्यनदीः प्रति समाधानात्मकं कृष्णवचनम्, श्रीकृष्णस्य निजधामगमनम् ॥ । 111
4.134.m: 129. Again, Kṛṣṇa's consoling of the people of Gokula; the prayer to Kṛṣṇa offered in the Bhāṇḍīra forest by Brahmā, Śiva, and others; the destruction of the Yādavas through the curse of a brahmin; the episode of the sinking of Dvārakā and other events; the liberation of the Pāṇḍavas; Kṛṣṇa's consoling words to the sacred rivers, such as the Jāhnavī, who were weeping in fear of the arrival of the Kali age; Śrī Kṛṣṇa's return to his own abode. ... 111

4.134.s: 130 nārāyaṇājñayā nāradena sṛṃjayakanyāyāḥ pāṇigrahaṇam, sanatkumāreṇa strīpremamagnāya nāradāya kṛtaḥ sadbodhapūrvakaḥ kṛṣṇamantropadeśaḥ, tapase gataṃ nāradaṃ prati kṛṣṇadhyānanirūpaṇātmakaṃ śivasya vacanam .... .. 60
4.134.d: 130 नारायणाज्ञया नारदेन सृंजयकन्यायाः पाणिग्रहणम्, सनत्कुमारेण स्त्रीप्रेममग्नाय नारदाय कृतः सद्बोधपूर्वकः कृष्णमन्त्रोपदेशः, तपसे गतं नारदं प्रति कृष्णध्याननिरूपणात्मकं शिवस्य वचनम् ॥॥ ॥ 60
4.134.m: 130. Nārada's taking the hand of the daughter of Sṛñjaya by the command of Nārāyaṇa; the instruction in the Kṛṣṇa mantra, preceded by sound counsel, given by Sanatkumāra to Nārada who was immersed in love for a woman; Śiva's speech expounding the meditation on Kṛṣṇa to Nārada who had gone to practice austerities. ... 60

4.134.s: 131 śaunakādyṛṣipraśnataḥ sūtena vahnisuvarṇayorutpattikathanam ... 38
4.134.d: 131 शौनकाद्यृषिप्रश्नतः सूतेन वह्निसुवर्णयोरुत्पत्तिकथनम् ॥। 38
4.134.m: 131. In response to the question of Śaunaka and the other sages, Sūta's narration of the origin of fire and gold. ... 38

4.134.s: 132 śaunakādikṛtapraśnānāṃ sūtena punaretadakhilabrahmavaivartapurāṇasya kathānāṃ krameṇa saṃkṣepataḥ kathanam .. ... 90
4.134.d: 132 शौनकादिकृतप्रश्नानां सूतेन पुनरेतदखिलब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराणस्य कथानां क्रमेण संक्षेपतः कथनम् ॥ ॥। 90
4.134.m: 132. In response to the questions asked by Śaunaka and others, Sūta's narration, again in sequential order and in brief, of all the stories of this Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa. ... 90

4.134.s: 133 śaunakādikānāṃ praśnataḥ sūtena purāṇalakṣaṇasaṃkhyādikathanam, etatpurāṇapraśaṃsā etatpurāṇaśravaṇapaṭhanaphalavarṇanam, etatpurāṇaśravaṇavidhikathanaṃ ca .. .. ... 74
4.134.d: 133 शौनकादिकानां प्रश्नतः सूतेन पुराणलक्षणसंख्यादिकथनम्, एतत्पुराणप्रशंसा एतत्पुराणश्रवणपठनफलवर्णनम्, एतत्पुराणश्रवणविधिकथनं च ॥ ॥ ॥। 74
4.134.m: 133. In response to the question of Śaunaka and others, Sūta's description of the characteristics, number of verses, and so forth of the Purāṇas; praise of this Purāṇa; description of the fruits of hearing and reciting this Purāṇa; and the statement of the rules for hearing this Purāṇa. ... 74
